3490-4050-6996-8333.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6996-8333.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

5170-6132-6273-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

1981-2415-4268-8249.easyPrerequisites:

When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

983-2645-3430-4644.description:

Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2023-4770-6723-7730.description:

Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

522-2034--5.description:

Repeat.

728-5751-6462-7104-7105.description:

Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.

Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.

Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.

2060-4038-4613-7426.easyPrerequisites:

2060-4038-4613-7426.description:

Activate Berta using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping them, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta's second ability triggers, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Berta, you may activate them using Crystalline Crawler's first activated ability any number of times, adding infinite mana.

Repeat from step 2.

Gain life in any way.

Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.

Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-4068-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

955-4289-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
955-4289-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
955-4289-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

222-527-5434-5686.description:

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1987-2468-3094-7434.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Brass Infiniscope and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.
1987-2468-3094-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.

Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.

Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.

Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3293-4826-5413-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
3293-4826-5413-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
3293-4826-5413-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Broodguard Elite enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Pitiless Plunderer and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Broodguard Elite from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.

You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3875-4270.description:
Play any land.

Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing from your hand onto the battlefield.

Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.

1479-3875-4270.notes: If the land card is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may instead tap it for mana instead of sacrificing the Treasure tokens. This would also allow you to instead create Food tokens if desired.

Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Thran Dynamo.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Thran Dynamo.
Repeat.

Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.

Activate Adun by paying {B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Cast Glorious Protector by paying {2}{W}{W}.
Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, triggering itself, exiling Lumbering Battlement and any number of other non-Angel creatures you control until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Felidar Guardian returns from exile to the battlefield due to Lumbering Battlement leaving the battlefield, triggering itself, blinking Glorious Protector.
Lumbering Battlement returns from exile to the battlefield without using the stack due to Glorious Protector leaving the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement and Glorious Protector enter the battlefield, they each trigger themselves.
Resolve Lumbering Battlement's trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Lumbering Battlement until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

643-2257-4508.description:

Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

23-776-1329-4563.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-4563.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Everflowing Chalice to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Everflowing Chalice.
Cast Everflowing Chalice.
